en.label: English
en.title: Privacy Policy
en.intro: LucrumTech ("we", "us", "our") is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the ePrivacy Directive.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
sections.body: LucrumTech is a product and engineering company based in Canada, with a team distributed across Canada and the European Union. Contact: hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
sections.body: We collect data only when you explicitly consent to it. This may include: browsing behaviour (pages visited, session duration, referral source) collected via Google Analytics 4 — only if you accept Analytics cookies; and preferences such as your chosen language and colour theme, stored locally in your browser.

sections.heading: 3. Legal basis for processing
sections.body: We process your data based on your freely given, specific, and informed consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You may withdraw this consent at any time. Strictly necessary data (e.g. session cookies required for the site to function) is processed under our legitimate interest in operating a secure and functional website.

sections.heading: 4. Google Analytics 4
sections.body: If you accept Analytics cookies, we use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors interact with our website. GA4 collects anonymised data including pages visited, session duration, device type, and general geographic location (country/city level). No personally identifiable information is collected. Data is processed by Google LLC under a Data Processing Agreement compliant with GDPR. Google may transfer data to the United States under Standard Contractual Clauses. Retention period: 14 months. You can opt out of Google Analytics across all websites at: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies and similar local storage technologies. See the table below for details. Your preferences are stored in your browser's localStorage under the key "lt_cookie_consent". No cookies are set before you provide consent.

sections.heading: 6. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data. We share data only with Google LLC (Analytics provider) when you have consented to analytics cookies. No other third parties receive your data from this website.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
sections.body: Analytics data is retained for 14 months in Google Analytics, after which it is automatically deleted. Preference data (language, theme) is stored locally in your browser and is never sent to our servers. You can clear this data at any time by clearing your browser's local storage.

sections.heading: 8. Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; request correction of inaccurate data; request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten"); withdraw consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing; lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. To exercise any right, contact us at hello@lucrumtech.com.

sections.heading: 9. Children's privacy
sections.body: Our website is not directed at children under the age of 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us immediately.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Withdraw or change your consent
sections.body: You can update your cookie preferences at any time by clicking the button below. This will reopen the cookie consent panel.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at hello@lucrumtech.com. We will respond within 30 days.

es.label: Español
es.title: Política de privacidad
es.intro: LucrumTech se compromete a proteger tus datos personales. Esta política explica qué datos recopilamos, por qué y cuáles son tus derechos según el RGPD.

sections.heading: 1. Quiénes somos
sections.body: LucrumTech es una empresa de producto e ingeniería con sede en Canadá, con un equipo distribuido entre Canadá y la Unión Europea. Contacto: hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: 2. Datos recopilados
sections.body: Solo recopilamos datos con tu consentimiento explícito: comportamiento de navegación a través de Google Analytics 4 (si aceptas las cookies analíticas) y preferencias de idioma/tema almacenadas localmente.

sections.heading: 3. Base legal
sections.body: Procesamos tus datos con base en tu consentimiento (Art. 6(1)(a) RGPD). Puedes retirarlo en cualquier momento.

sections.heading: 4. Google Analytics 4
sections.body: Con tu consentimiento, GA4 recopila datos anonimizados: páginas visitadas, duración de sesión, tipo de dispositivo, ubicación aproximativa. No se recopilan datos personales identificables. Retención: 14 meses.

sections.heading: 5. Tus derechos
sections.body: Tienes derecho a acceder, rectificar, eliminar tus datos y retirar tu consentimiento. Contacto: hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: Retirar o cambiar tu consentimiento
sections.body: Puedes actualizar tus preferencias de cookies en cualquier momento haciendo clic en el botón de abajo.

sections.heading: Contacto
sections.body: Para consultas sobre privacidad: hello@lucrumtech.com

consent.title: Tu privacidad, tu elección
consent.subtitle: Usamos cookies para mejorar tu experiencia y analizar el tráfico del sitio. Tú controlas exactamente qué recopilamos.

de.label: Deutsch
de.title: Datenschutzrichtlinie
de.intro: LucrumTech verpflichtet sich zum Schutz Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten. Diese Richtlinie erklärt, welche Daten wir erheben, warum und welche Rechte Sie gemäß DSGVO haben.

sections.heading: 1. Wer wir sind
sections.body: LucrumTech ist ein Produkt- und Engineering-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Kanada und einem Team, das über Kanada und die Europäische Union verteilt ist. Kontakt: hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: 2. Erhobene Daten
sections.body: Wir erheben Daten nur mit Ihrer ausdrücklichen Zustimmung: Surfverhalten via Google Analytics 4 (wenn Sie Analyse-Cookies akzeptieren) sowie Sprach- und Themeneinstellungen, die lokal gespeichert werden.

sections.heading: 3. Rechtsgrundlage
sections.body: Wir verarbeiten Ihre Daten auf Grundlage Ihrer Einwilligung (Art. 6 Abs. 1 lit. a DSGVO). Sie können diese jederzeit widerrufen.

sections.heading: 4. Google Analytics 4
sections.body: Bei Akzeptanz von Analyse-Cookies erhebt GA4 anonymisierte Daten: besuchte Seiten, Sitzungsdauer, Gerätetyp, ungefährer Standort. Keine personenbezogenen Daten. Aufbewahrungsdauer: 14 Monate.

sections.heading: 5. Ihre Rechte
sections.body: Sie haben das Recht auf Auskunft, Berichtigung, Löschung und Widerruf Ihrer Einwilligung. Kontakt: hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: Einwilligung widerrufen oder ändern
sections.body: Sie können Ihre Cookie-Einstellungen jederzeit durch Klick auf den Button unten aktualisieren.

sections.heading: Kontakt
sections.body: Für datenschutzbezogene Fragen: hello@lucrumtech.com

consent.title: Ihre Privatsphäre, Ihre Wahl
consent.subtitle: Wir verwenden Cookies, um Ihre Erfahrung zu verbessern und den Website-Verkehr zu analysieren. Sie bestimmen, was wir erfassen.

fr.label: Français
fr.title: Politique de confidentialité
fr.intro: LucrumTech s'engage à protéger vos données personnelles. Cette politique explique les données que nous collectons, pourquoi nous les collectons, et vos droits en vertu du RGPD.

sections.heading: 1. Qui sommes-nous
sections.body: LucrumTech est une société de produit et d’ingénierie basée au Canada, avec une équipe répartie entre le Canada et l’Union européenne. Contact : hello@lucrumtech.com

sections.heading: 2. Données collectées

sections.heading: 3. Base légale

sections.heading: 4. Google Analytics 4
sections.body: Si vous acceptez les cookies analytiques, GA4 collecte des données anonymisées : pages visitées, durée de session, type d'appareil, localisation approximative. Aucune donnée personnelle identifiable n'est collectée. Conservation : 14 mois.

sections.heading: 5. Vos droits
sections.body: Vous avez le droit d'accéder à vos données, de les rectifier, de les supprimer, et de retirer votre consentement. Contactez-nous à hello@lucrumtech.com.

sections.heading: Retirer ou modifier votre consentement
sections.body: Vous pouvez mettre à jour vos préférences de cookies à tout moment en cliquant sur le bouton ci-dessous.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Pour toute question relative à la confidentialité : hello@lucrumtech.com
